future_contributions.gap: Lack of standardized datasets for multimodal emotion detection
future_contributions.proposed_contribution: Federated learning framework for cross-institutional multimodal emotion dataset creation
future_contributions.technical_approach: Develop a decentralized data aggregation system enabling institutions to contribute anonymized keystroke, physiological, and textual data while preserving privacy through differential privacy and secure multi-party computation
future_contributions.expected_impact: Enables reproducible research across diverse populations and contexts while maintaining data sovereignty, addressing calibration issues through standardized feature normalization protocols
future_contributions.implementation_feasibility: Leverages existing federated learning infrastructure (e.g., TensorFlow Federated) and open-source data anonymization tools, with potential partnerships with HCI and biomedical research institutions

future_contributions.gap: Inconsistent methodologies in keystroke dynamics research
future_contributions.proposed_contribution: Automated protocol validation system for keystroke dynamics experiments
future_contributions.technical_approach: Create a benchmarking platform with standardized preprocessing pipelines, cross-validation schemes, and performance metrics (F1-score, AUC-ROC) to compare different keystroke analysis techniques across datasets
future_contributions.expected_impact: Resolves reproducibility issues by enforcing methodological rigor, enabling fair comparison of approaches and accelerating progress in the field
future_contributions.implementation_feasibility: Builds on existing open-source ML frameworks with modular components for data preprocessing, feature extraction, and evaluation, compatible with standard HCI datasets

future_contributions.gap: Need for robust non-intrusive physiological measurement techniques
future_contributions.proposed_contribution: Hybrid sensor fusion model for enhanced non-contact emotion inference
future_contributions.technical_approach: Integrate camera-based PPG with microphone-derived voice stress analysis and electrostatic discharge sensors, using LSTM networks to correlate multimodal signals with emotional states
future_contributions.expected_impact: Overcomes accuracy limitations of single-sensor approaches by leveraging cross-modal redundancy, enabling reliable emotion detection in real-world environments
future_contributions.implementation_feasibility: Utilizes off-the-shelf consumer electronics sensors and open-source signal processing libraries, with potential for integration into smart devices

future_contributions.gap: Limited theoretical frameworks for integrating multimodal data
future_contributions.technical_approach: Develop a tensor factorization framework modeling interactions between keystroke dynamics, physiological signals, and textual features as a heterogeneous graph, with attention mechanisms for modality-specific weighting
future_contributions.expected_impact: Provides a cohesive theoretical foundation for multimodal integration, enabling more accurate emotion detection through cross-modal contextual understanding
future_contributions.implementation_feasibility: Builds on existing graph neural network architectures and tensor decomposition techniques, with potential for implementation in PyTorch or TensorFlow

future_contributions.technical_approach: Implement a semi-supervised learning framework using heart rate variability and skin conductance levels as objective labels, with active learning to iteratively refine emotion annotations from unlabeled data
future_contributions.expected_impact: Reduces subjectivity in emotion labeling while maintaining empirical validity, enabling more reliable training of emotion detection models
future_contributions.implementation_feasibility: Leverages existing physiological signal processing tools and active learning algorithms, with potential for integration with wearable devices

future_contributions.gap: User identification under emotional state influences
future_contributions.technical_approach: Design a dynamic authentication protocol that combines keystroke dynamics with real-time emotion detection, using adaptive thresholding and multi-modal fusion to compensate for emotional state-induced behavior changes
future_contributions.expected_impact: Enhances security in emotionally variable environments while maintaining usability, addressing critical limitations in current authentication systems
future_contributions.implementation_feasibility: Builds on existing biometric authentication frameworks with added emotion detection modules, compatible with mobile and desktop platforms
